title: propose
description: Method `propose`: scaffold a change proposal under `.meltemi/changes/<name>/` deterministically, then delegate the content of proposal.md to the configured ACP agent (cwd at the project root). Session progress streams via `session/event`; agent permission requests flow via `permission/request`.

turnStatus.description: Final status of the agent turn, mapped from the ACP stop reason (end_turn -> completed).

idea.description: Free-form description of the change to propose. The change name is derived from it deterministically (kebab-case).

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the root of the target repository. `.meltemi/changes/` is created here if missing.

changeName.description: Kebab-case change name derived from the idea.

proposalPath.description: Absolute path of the created proposal.md.

deniedPermissions.description: How many of the agent's permission requests were denied during the turn (rule, human, or timeout/default). Greater than zero means the artifact may be incomplete. Absent is equivalent to 0.
